clauses.mechanism: express revocation of EO 9172 performed by this order itself on August 11, 1947 (no effective-date wording; self-executing command spent on performance)
clauses.reason: The sole clause, the paragraph beginning "NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the", orders Executive Order 9172 of May 22, 1942 (establishing a panel for the creation of emergency boards for the adjustment of railway labor disputes) revoked, in words that read "be, and it is hereby," and then, on the next line, "revoked." The Federal Register text prints the signature date "August 11, 1947." and a filing line whose date is August 11, 1947. The sentence has no effective-date wording, so the command to revoke was performed, and so exhausted, on signing, August 11, 1947. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of the order itself. No later instrument, amendment, extension or earlier event alters or ends the command: the dossier chain is empty and the order states no until-date, report date or condition.

research_rationale:
EO 9883 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9883.txt, 12 FR 5481, PDF page 1); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order's one operative sentence revokes Executive Order 9172 of May 22, 1942. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The Federal Register text prints the signature date "August 11, 1947." and a filing line with the filing date August 11, 1947. The operative sentence has no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, August 11, 1947. Under owner ruling 2026-10-28 (evidence decides) a command that was performed on its date is recorded as exhausted by performance on that date.

savings.reason: The order contains no savings, transfer or residual clause; it only revokes Executive Order 9172. The machine searches of the U.S. Code and the eCFR (both as of the October 14, 2026 cutoff, edition caveats stated in their coverage notes) and the Federal Register catalog return no hit citing EO 9883, so no held source continues any command of this order.
